blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Matching the same vehicle across front and rear cameras is difficult because the cameras do not share a view and the vehicle’s appearance changes substantially. We introduce Front2Back-ReID, a benchmark of 500 manually verified vehicle handovers from 20 recording sequences in South Africa. Each example asks a model to match a vehicle highlighted in a front-camera image to the same vehicle among at least three candidates in a later rear-camera image. We evaluate seven zero-shot vision-language models, four image-retrieval baselines, and 25 human participants. Models are tested using full front RGB images, cropped target vehicles, and binary silhouettes. The strongest VLM achieved 76.6% Rank-1 accuracy on target crops, compared with 74.0% for the frozen SigLIP2 baseline; this difference was not statistically clear. Human participants achieved 94.0% accuracy with full images and 92.2% with target crops. Under our evaluation setup, enabling reasoning improved accuracy across all three input conditions for every model evaluated in both modes. We also found that VLMs generally performed worse on full scenes than on target crops. These results show that general-purpose VLMs do not yet consistently outperform strong visual retrieval for front-to-rear vehicle matching, while humans remain substantially more reliable.
blocks.zh: 很难在前后相机上搭配同一车辆,因为相机不具有相同视野,而且车辆的外观也发生了很大变化。 我们采用Front2Back-ReID,这是南非20个记录序列中500个人工核实车辆移交的基准。 每个例子都要求有一个模型,在后来的后相机图像中,在至少三名候选人中,将前相机图像突出显示的车辆与同一车辆相匹配。 我们评价7个零镜头的视觉语言模型、4个图像检索基线和25个人类参与者。 模型采用全前置RGB图像,裁剪目标车辆,以及二进制硅瓦进行测试. 最强的VLM在目标作物上取得了76.6%的排名-1精确度,而冻结的SigLIP2基线则为74.0%;这一差异在统计学上并不明显. 人类参与者以完整图像达到94.0%的精度,目标作物达到92.2%。 根据我们的评价设置,对在两种模式中评价的每个模型来说,使能推理提高了所有三种输入条件的准确性。 我们还发现,VLM在全场的表现通常比在目标作物上表现更差. 这些结果表明,通用VLM在前向车辆配对方面尚未始终如一地超过强大的视觉检索,而人类则保持相当的可靠性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Although the Waymo Open Dataset’s End-to-End Driving collection and similar datasets provide images from eight cameras covering the full 360 ∘ around the vehicle [ 29 ] , resource-constrained settings motivate methods for simpler rigs with fewer views, making identity association across gaps in coverage particularly important. Recent work studies vehicle matching across non-overlapping cameras [ 11 ] and uses temporal features and motion prediction to maintain tracks through occlusions [ 18 ] . We focus on front-to-rear matching: identifying a vehicle seen ahead when it later appears behind the ego vehicle, without intervening observations, a fixed inter-view time interval, or a reliable front-to-rear transform.

blocks.en: Such handovers arise during overtakes, pass-bys, turns, merges, and intersection crossings. Large viewpoint changes [ 4 ] and new distractors in the rear scene complicate identity matching. We evaluate zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) on a focused task: given one highlighted front target and a closed rear gallery, which candidate is the same vehicle? Each gallery contains at least three candidates, including exactly one match. This evaluates identity association across an observation gap.
blocks.zh: 这种交接在过关、过关、转弯、合并和交叉时发生。 大视线变化[4],后场新增分散视线使身份匹配复杂化. 我们评价零镜头的视觉语言模型(VLMs)是一项重点突出的任务:给一个突出的正面目标以及一个封闭的后方画廊,哪个候选者是同一载体? 每个画廊至少包含3名候选人,其中包括1名完全匹配的候选人. 这评估了跨越观察差距的身份联系。

blocks.en: Motivated by diagnostic evaluations of VLM visual grounding [ 6 ] , we examine whether zero-shot VLMs offer an advantage over frozen visual retrieval and how their performance changes with the supplied evidence. We keep the rear gallery unchanged and show the front target in three forms: the full RGB scene, a target crop, and a binary silhouette. These comparisons reveal how models respond to different presentations of the same target. Because context, target scale, and representation also change, they do not isolate the effects of context or reasoning alone.
blocks.zh: 基于对VLM视觉定位的诊断评估[6],我们审查零镜头VLM是否比冷冻视觉检索有优势,以及它们的表现如何随着提供的证据而变化。 我们保持后方画廊不变,并以三种形式显示前方目标:完整的RGB场景,一个目标作物,以及一个二进制圆筒. 这些比较揭示了模型如何响应同一目标的不同表述. 由于上下文,目标尺度,和表示也有所变化,它们并不孤立仅是上下文或推理的效果.

blocks.en: Front2Back-ReID contains 500 manually verified handovers from 20 South African recording sequences. We evaluate seven VLMs across the three input conditions, four crop-based retrieval controls, and 25 human participants on full-RGB and target-crop trials. The strongest completed VLM achieves 76.6% Rank-1 accuracy on crops, versus 74.0% for frozen SigLIP2, but this difference is not statistically significant. Humans achieve 94.0% on full scenes and 92.2% on crops. Under the shared prompt protocol, crops outperform full scenes in every informative, VLM comparison.
blocks.zh: Front2Back-ReID包含从20个南非录音序列中手动核实的500个移交. 我们在三个输入条件中评价了7个甚高频,4个作物检索控制,25个人类参与者进行了全RGB和目标作物试验。 最强完成的VLM在作物上达到76.6%的排名1精度,而冷冻的SigLIP2则达到74.0%,但这一差异在统计学上并不显著. 人类在全场实现94.0%,农作物达到92.2%。 根据共享的即时协议,作物在每一次信息化,VLM比较中的表现都超过全部场景.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. A front-to-rear association benchmark: 500 asymmetric, closed-gallery handovers from 20 South African recording sequences, with manually verified identities and difficulty annotations. 2. A diagnostic study of visual evidence: seven zero-shot VLMs evaluated with full scenes, target crops, and binary silhouettes, alongside four crop-based retrieval controls and a 25-participant human reference. The best completed VLM shows no statistically significant advantage over SigLIP2 on crops, and crops outperform full scenes in every informative, completed VLM comparison.

blocks.en:
Large viewpoint change, especially between front and rear views, is a
well-known difficulty. Methods address it with viewpoint-dependent
metrics [ 4 ] , local features and reranking [ 27 ] , generated-view adaptation [ 25 ] , alignment of visible
regions [ 15 ] , view-invariant pretraining [ 26 ] , and fusion of complementary
views [ 30 ] . We do not propose another such method.
Instead, we ask how well existing systems use identity cues across views
when evaluated under shared conditions.

blocks.en:
Front2Back-ReID changes both the viewpoint setting and the geography. The
cameras ride on the ego vehicle, so a target leaves the front camera’s view
and reappears in the rear camera from a very different viewpoint after a
blind interval, among K i ≥ 3 K_{i}\geq 3 candidates supplied by surrounding
traffic. Fixed galleries and controlled front evidence let us compare
zero-shot VLMs, frozen retrieval models, and humans on the same decisions.
The recordings come from South African roads, where the mix of vehicles, the layout of the road, and the driving conditions differ from those of existing benchmarks. To our knowledge, Front2Back-ReID is the first vehicle Re-ID benchmark recorded on Southern African roads.

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation Models for Visual Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉检索基础模型

blocks.en:
Foundation models are increasingly used for vehicle Re-ID, but usually
after task-specific training; CLIP-ReID, for example, fine-tunes CLIP on
standard person and vehicle benchmarks [ 10 ] . Used frozen,
encoders such as DINOv2 [ 17 ] and
SigLIP2 [ 22 ] are strong general-purpose matchers,
but they are trained to group similar content, not to separate individual
instances: two white sedans may look alike to them. It has been shown that this blind spot carries over to multimodal models, whose errors trace to visually distinct images with similar CLIP embeddings [ 21 ] . Since modern VLMs commonly rely on pretrained visual encoders, we use frozen DINOv2 and SigLIP2 as representation baselines. ranking rear candidates by crop-level embedding similarity therefore lets us ask whether language supervision improves visual identity matching, and whether generative multimodal models add gains beyond embedding similarity on the cross-view vehicle Re-ID task.

blocks.en: 2.3 Visual and Spatial Reasoning in VLMs
blocks.zh: 2.3 VLMs的视觉和空间原因

blocks.en:
Recent VLMs have gained the abilities our task appears to need.
LLaVA-OneVision is trained across single-image, multi-image, and video
tasks [ 8 ] ; Qwen2.5-VL processes images at dynamic
resolution and can localize objects [ 1 ] ; SpatialVLM
improves spatial reasoning through dedicated
supervision [ 3 ] ; and V* uses language-guided search
to find small details in crowded, high-resolution
images [ 28 ] . Applying such models zero-shot to Re-ID in
driving is only beginning: the closest study has a VLM describe each
object crop and matches the descriptions in language
space [ 2 ] . We instead ask VLMs to compare images directly, with no video or cross-rig geometry to fall back on. Full scenes versus target crops test whether context helps, and running each model with and without reasoning(for applicable models) tests whether extended reasoning improves performance.

blocks.en: 2.4 Diagnostic Benchmarks for Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: 2.4 视力定位诊断基准

blocks.en:
Several benchmarks test whether VLMs ground their answers in the image.
HallusionBench uses controlled question pairs to expose hallucination and
visual illusion [ 6 ] , MuirBench pairs multi-image
questions with unanswerable variants [ 24 ] , and MIHBench
tests whether models keep object identity consistent across images,
finding that errors depend on how many images are shown and where
distractors appear [ 9 ] . These benchmarks probe grounding
by varying the question or the image set. Front2Back-ReID instead holds the
rear gallery fixed and varies only the form of the front evidence (RGB,
crop, or silhouette), on real handovers where viewpoint reverses and
traffic supplies the distractors. Frozen retrieval baselines and human evaluators on the same galleries show whether an instance is solvable from appearance alone.

blocks.zh: 3.1 任务定义

blocks.en: An overview of Front2Back-ReID is shown in Fig. 2 , including benchmark construction, task setup, evidence conditions, and evaluation. Each example pairs a front-left image containing one highlighted vehicle with a later rear-left image containing K i ≥ 3 K_{i}\geq 3 labelled candidates. The task is to select the unique candidate matching the front target; all others are distractors (Fig. 1 ). No intervening video, front-to-rear transform, or range estimates are supplied to matchers.

blocks.en: We recorded 20 sequences on different days and at different locations. We mounted two low-cost MMLove stereo cameras, shown in Fig. 3 , on the vehicle: one on the windscreen facing forward and one on the rear window facing backward. Each costs under US$100, has a 60 mm stereo baseline, and records at 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 pixels and 30 fps. Camera streams were software-synchronized during recording and downsampled to 10 fps for processing.

Each model sees the same rear gallery with three versions of the front

prompts. Figure 6 gives the full prompt.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en:
Front2Back-ReID covers 500 handovers from 20 recordings in five South African
cities, about 1.9 hours of driving. While limited, it is designed for controlled
comparison of methods on real handovers, not for broad claims about other
countries, fleets, or sensors. Daytime scenes dominate (97.6%), so night
and adverse weather are underrepresented, and depth is available for 341
pairs, which limits range analysis to that subset. Our evidence conditions
change more than one factor at a time; a crop, for example, removes
context but also enlarges the target, so we interpret them as effects of
input presentation. Finally, our intervals treat pairs as independent, and
each pair has one human judgment per condition. Resampling by recording
and collecting more judgments per pair would give more conservative
intervals and a sharper human reference.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Front2Back-ReID, a benchmark of 500 verified front-to-rear
vehicle handovers recorded with low-cost cameras on South African roads,
where no calibrated transform links the front and rear views. Holding each
rear gallery fixed, we varied the front evidence between full scene,
target crop, and silhouette, and compared zero-shot VLMs, frozen retrieval
models, and 25 human participants on the same decisions. Three findings
stand out.

First, the best VLM, reasoning-enabled GPT-5.5, reaches 76.6%
on crops, not significantly above the frozen SigLIP2 encoder at 74.0%,
while humans reach 92.2–94.0%. Secondly, full scenes yield lower accuracy than
target crops for every informative VLM run by 6.6–16.4 points without reasoning, whereas
humans score 1.8 points higher with full RGB scenes. Cropping also changes
target scale, so this difference cannot be attributed to context alone;
reasoning does not remove the observed VLM gap.
blocks.zh:
第一,最佳VLM,推理辅助GPT-5.5,达到76.6%.
在作物上,没有显著高于74.0%的冷冻SigLIP2编码器,
而人类则达到92.2–94.0%. 第二,整个场景的准确度低于
6.6-16.4分,毫无道理地运行,而
人类以完整的RGB场景得分较高1.8分. 裁剪也会改变
目标尺度,因此这种差异不能单独归因于上下文;
推理不能消除观察到的 VLM 差距。

blocks.en:
Third, small rear targets separate models from humans, whose
accuracy stays nearly flat across difficulty strata. Front2Back-ReID thus
offers a focused test of cross-view identity association for settings
where calibrated multi-sensor rigs are out of reach. We plan to
extend this work to night driving, diverse weather conditions and more regions, adding the intervening video so methods can use motion between views, and developing methods that make better use of scene context for identity matching, rather than being distracted by it.
blocks.zh:
第三,小后方目标 与人类分离的模型。
准确度在困难阶层之间几乎保持不变。 Front2Back-ReID 由此而来
对设置的交叉视图身份协会进行重点测试
校准的多传感器钻机无法到达的地方 我们计划
将这项工作推广到夜间驾驶,不同的天气条件和更多的区域,增加插座视频,这样方法就可以在观点之间运动,并开发出更好的利用场景背景进行身份匹配的方法,而不是被它分心.

blocks.en: S2 Additional protocol details and difficult cases
blocks.zh: S2 附加议定书的细节和困难案件

blocks.en: Each front-evidence condition uses the same rear gallery. Candidate aliases remain visible, while coordinates, detector classes, and detector confidence scores are withheld. The prompt instructs models not to use candidate order, position, box size, or road plausibility as identity evidence, although visual ordering remains apparent. A crop removes scene context and changes the target’s effective scale. Figure S1 illustrates four challenging cases under this protocol.
blocks.zh: 每个前证条件都使用相同的后照道. 候选人的别名仍然可见,而坐标,探测器类,探测器自信分数则被扣. 即时指示模型不要使用候选命令,位置,箱大小,或道路可信度作为身份证据,尽管视觉命令仍然明显. 裁剪会去除场景背景并改变目标的有效尺度 。 图S1显示了该议定书下的四个具有挑战性的案件。

Rows show (a) many vehicle candidates ( V i = 14 V_{i}{=}14 ), (b) a distant front target ( ≈ 113 \approx 113 m approximate stereo depth), (c) front-target occlusion ( ≈ 61 % \approx 61\% ), and (d) boundary truncation.
blocks.zh: 图S1:Front2Back-ReID的难以移交. 列显示标记的全RGB查询、目标作物和固定的后方画廊。 人类参与者看到了两个前置输入之一,没有看到答案说明. 绿色标记比赛和红色的分散阅读器;探测器课被省略,人们模糊不清. 行显示(a)许多车辆考生(V i = 14 V_{i}{=}14),(b)远前目标(≈113\约113米约约立体深度),(c)前目标隔离(≈61%\约61\%),(d)边界截断.

blocks.en: S3 Evidence-condition comparisons
blocks.zh: S3 证据条件比较

blocks.en: From the reasoning-disabled results in Table 3 of the main paper, crops improve Rank-1 accuracy over full RGB by 6.6 points for Llama 4 Scout, 11.0 for Qwen 3.6 27B, 16.4 for GPT-5.5, 13.8 for GPT-5.4 mini, and 13.4 for Gemini 2.5 Flash. Their respective losses from crop to silhouette are 27.2, 42.4, 38.0, 29.8, and 38.8 points. These are observed differences, without separate significance tests. They reflect changes in input presentation, including target scale and available cues. LLaVA-OneVision returned C1 throughout, so its unchanged accuracy does not show insensitivity to the missing evidence.
blocks.zh: 从主要论文表3的推理缺陷结果来看,作物的Rank-1精度比全RGB提高6.6分,Llama 4 Scout,11.0分,Quen 3.6 27B,16.4分,GPT-5.5,13.8分,GPT-5.4迷你,13.4分,双子座2.5 Flash. 它们各自从作物到疏林的损失分别为27.2,42.4,38.0,29.8和38.8分. 这些是观察到的差异,没有单独的意义测试. 它们反映了投入列报方式的变化,包括目标规模和可用提示。 LLaVA-One Vision在整段时间里都返回了C1,所以其不变的准确性并不表明对缺失的证据不敏感.

blocks.en: S4 Paired reasoning comparisons
blocks.zh: S4 Paired 推理比较

blocks.en: Figure 9 in the main paper compares medium-effort reasoning with reasoning disabled on the same pairs. Its 95% BCa intervals use 100,000 paired resamples. GPT-5.4 mini gained 14.2 points on full RGB [ 9.4 , 19.0 ] [9.4,19.0] , 12.6 on crops [ 8.4 , 16.8 ] [8.4,16.8] , and 11.4 on silhouettes [ 6.8 , 16.0 ] [6.8,16.0] . GPT-5.5 gained 4.4 points on full RGB [ 0.4 , 8.4 ] [0.4,8.4] and 7.0 on silhouettes [ 3.2 , 11.0 ] [3.2,11.0] ; Gemini 2.5 Flash gained 6.8 on silhouettes [ 2.2 , 11.4 ] [2.2,11.4] .

The remaining paired intervals cross zero: GPT-5.5 crops, + 1.8 +1.8 points [ − 1.2 , 4.8 ] [-1.2,4.8] ; Gemini 2.5 Flash full RGB, + 3.8 +3.8 [ − 0.4 , 8.0 ] [-0.4,8.0] ; and Gemini 2.5 Flash crops, + 3.2 +3.2 [ − 0.8 , 7.2 ] [-0.8,7.2] . Thus, reasoning helped GPT-5.4 mini across all three inputs, but the evidence for gains in the other matched cells is mixed. In particular, the best crop result (GPT-5.5) has no clear paired reasoning gain.
blocks.zh: 其余的配对间隔跨0:GPT-5.5作物,+1.8+1.8分[−1.2,4.8] [-1.2,4.8];双子2.5闪光全RGB,+3.8+3.8 [−0.4,8.0] [-0.4,8.0];双子2.5闪光作物,+3.2+3.2 [−0.8,7.2] [-0.8,7.2]. 因此,推理有助于GPT-5.4小于所有三种输入,但其他匹配单元格中的收益证据参差不齐。 特别是,最佳作物结果(GPT-5.5)没有明确的配对推理结果。

blocks.en: S5 Human accuracy, latency, and errors
blocks.zh: S5 人的准确性、延迟性和错误

blocks.en: Each of the 25 participants answered 20 full-RGB and 20 crop trials, without seeing the same pair twice. Each pair received one judgment per condition from different participants. The main-paper timing plot uses all 1,000 judgments: 470 correct and 30 incorrect on full RGB, and 461 correct and 39 incorrect on crops.
blocks.zh: 25名参与者每人回答20个全RGB和20个作物试验,没有两次看到同一对. 每一对都得到不同参与者的每个条件的一个判断。 主纸计时图采用全部1000个判断:全RGB470个正确和30个不正确,农作物461个正确和39个不正确.

blocks.en: These give accuracies of 94.0% and 92.2%, respectively. Pooled human-stratum intervals resample individual responses, without clustering by pair or participant; they describe uncertainty under that sampling choice.
blocks.zh: 这分别是94.0%和92.2%。 集合的人类-层间距重新对单个反应进行采样,不按对子或参与者进行组合;它们描述的是该取样选择下的不确定性。

blocks.en: S5.1 Decision latency
blocks.zh: S5.1 决定延迟

blocks.en: S6 Qualitative model reasoning examples
blocks.zh: S6 定性模型推理实例

blocks.en: The response schema requested one short sentence citing visual evidence. Table S3 shows four saved front-crop responses: two correct matches and two errors based on plausible but misleading cues. These sentences are model outputs, not verified explanations of the models’ decisions.

blocks.zh: 表S3: 前耕试验中保存的示范证据判决。 “GT”是正确的后设计别名;R表示中效推理。

blocks.en: S7 Depth sensitivity
blocks.zh: S7 深度敏感性

blocks.en: Approximate front-stereo depth is available for 341 pairs. Across five equal-frequency depth bins, crop accuracy is non-monotonic for all three plotted methods (Fig. S6 , left). Normalized front-target area shows a clearer association with accuracy (right): SigLIP2 rises from 50.0% in the smallest-area quintile to 91.0% in the largest, while GPT-5.5 changes less. These binned comparisons support the main paper’s scale analysis; they do not isolate scale from other properties of the examples.

Points are placed at each bin’s median depth or area. Depth shows no monotonic trend; SigLIP2 improves as target area increases.

blocks.en: S8 Recording-sequence durations
blocks.zh: S8 记录序列持续时间

blocks.en: Twenty-one sequences were recorded, of which 20 contribute accepted pairs to the benchmark. The 21 recordings total approximately 1.9 hours; durations range from 46 seconds to 17.2 minutes, with a median of 4.7 minutes (Fig. S7 ).

blocks.en: S9 Excluded incomplete runs
blocks.zh: S9 排除不完整运行

blocks.en: The main-paper interval analyses include only complete N = 500 N=500 runs. The reasoning-enabled Qwen 3.6 27B runs reached 470/500 full-RGB, 480/500 crop, and 416/500 silhouette trials before repeated Groq request failures and truncated completions prevented completion. We exclude these incomplete runs. Provider failures and empty or truncated outputs were not scored; non-empty outputs that could not be parsed or selected an unlisted candidate counted as incorrect. This records the limits of these runs under the evaluated settings, not a reliability ranking of model families or providers.
blocks.zh: 主纸间隔分析只包括完整的N=500N=500运行. 推理带动的Quen 3.6 27B运行达到470/500全RGB,480/500作物,以及416/500硅胶试验,之后格罗克再三请求失败,短程完成也阻止完成. 我们排除了这些不完整的运行。 提供方的失败和空或短的产出没有得分;无法解析或挑选出未列入清单的候选人的非空产出被算作不正确。 这记录了在评价的环境下这些限制的限度,而不是模范家庭或提供者的可靠性排名。
